tagline: Arsenal胶片单反相机，1984 年发布
description: Arsenal于1984年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Arsenal Volna-3 MC (ВОЛНА), 80mm f/2.8, automatic diaphragm, interchangeable。快门速度Curtain-type cloth focal plane shutter, setting: dial on the left of the top plate, horizontal travel, speeds: 2-1/1000 +B。使用120 roll, picture size 6x6 cm。Fresnel matte screen w/ central microprism collar around the split image rangefinder, ring on the lens.。

specs.镜头: Arsenal Volna-3 MC (ВОЛНА), 80mm f/2.8, automatic diaphragm, interchangeable
specs.对焦: Fresnel matte screen w/ central microprism collar around the split image rangefinder, ring on the lens.
specs.快门: Curtain-type cloth focal plane shutter, setting: dial on the left of the top plate, horizontal travel, speeds: 2-1/1000 +B
specs.取景器: Eye-level SLR pentaprism finder, interchangeable with waist level finder
specs.曝光测光: Full aperture TTL, CdS cell in prism, metering zone is the oval shaped, central part of the viewfinder field, (full aperture metering depends on the shutter cocking)
specs.英文简介: Kiev 60 is a medium format SLR film system camera manufactured by Arsenal Factory, in Kiev, Ukraine, former USSR, and produced between 1984-99.
